models.name: Ninfer6000
models.summary: Did a great job setting the search count, bigger count (5) at first, down to 3 as it became more specific. Great variety of info, misc Strix Halo boxes, GB10, new 192gb framework, M5 Ultra and Max. Created all the tasks, but cluster-closed them all right before generating output. Gave a malformed tool call when asked to create the one-pager. Used the wrong tool name format.

models.name: vLLM
models.summary: Search pattern deviated a bit from Ninfer6000. Did bigger searches up front, then fetched from those rather than search->think->search repeated. Got information regarding the same expected set. Handled the tasks well but failed to close the final one after generating output.

models.name: llama.cpp
models.summary: Search pattern was more similar to ninfer6000. Did modulate `n` as it felt necessary. Found most expected items, didn't mention the M5 Max as an option though. Cluster closed created tasks.
